headlines.description: — Tage Thompson scored three times, including the 200th of his career, and added two assists in the Buffalo Sabres' 5-3 win over the Montreal Canadiens on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tage Thompson's 3-goal, 5-point outing leads Buffalo Sabres to 5-3 win over Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Sidney Crosby scored one of Pittsburgh's three power-play goals and the Penguins beat the Philadelphia Flyers 6-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crosby helps Penguins power past Flyers 6-3

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Washington Capitals

headlines.description: — Collin Graf and Pavol Regenda each had a goal and an assist and the San Jose Sharks used a three-goal second period to top the Washington Capitals 3-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sharks' 3-goal second period keys 3-2 victory over Capitals
